description: This source file provides functions for extracting and encoding application keys from URLs, including stripping user info, query, and fragment parts, and encoding the result in a URL-safe base64 format.

methods.name: StripUserInfo
methods.description: Removes username and password from a URL string if present.

methods.name: StripQuery
methods.description: Removes the query part from a URL string if present.

methods.name: StripFragment
methods.description: Removes the fragment part from a URL string if present.

methods.name: ExtractAppKey
methods.description: Extracts the main part of a URL by stripping user info, query, and fragment.

methods.name: EncodeAppKey
methods.description: Encodes a string into URL-safe base64 format.
